distinctions: scan-action-2-7 features aromatic, high-acid white wines (Global Riesling) offering exceptional price-to-quality ratios under $20 with notes of peach, lime, crisp acidity, and minerality.

scan-action-2-8 represents full-bodied Southern Hemisphere red wines (Australian Shiraz) providing high-value offerings under $25 scoring around 90 points with flavors of blackberry, black pepper, and savory meat.

subdivision-action-4-2 encompasses high-acid, structured Northern Italian red wines (Piedmont Barbera and entry Nebbiolo) delivering solid everyday value with bright acidity, firm tannins, red cherry, and rose notes.
subdivision-action-4-5 captures Mediterranean warm-climate reds (Sicilian Nero d'Avola) at very accessible price points, featuring profiles of dark blackberry, tobacco, and warm spices.
